panels.title: Radios
panels.description: Distinct device/radio/interface combinations reporting in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_id || '|' || radio || '|' || ifname) AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}';

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Latest total client population across selected radios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(client_count),0) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,radio,ifname) device_id,radio,ifname,client_count FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY device_id,radio,ifname,timestamp DESC) x;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(channel_utilization_pct)::numeric,1) AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cca_busy_pct)::numeric,1) AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(interference_utilization_pct)::numeric,1) AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weak_client_count),0) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,radio,ifname) device_id,radio,ifname,weak_client_count FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY device_id,radio,ifname,timestamp DESC) x;

SELECT timestamp AS time, channel_utilization_pct AS "Channel Utilization %", device_id || ' / ' || radio || ' / ch' || channel::text AS series FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time, cca_busy_pct AS "CCA Busy %", device_id || ' / ' || radio || ' / ch' || channel::text AS series FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time, obss_utilization_pct AS "OBSS %", interference_utilization_pct AS "Interference %" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Average RSSI
panels.description: Client-dependent metric. Zero is treated as N/A when no clients are connected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, NULLIF(avg_rssi_dbm,0) AS "Average RSSI dBm" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND client_count > 0 AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Average SNR
panels.description: Client-dependent metric. Zero is treated as N/A when no clients are connected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, NULLIF(avg_snr_db,0) AS "Average SNR dB" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND client_count > 0 AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Average TX / RX Rate
panels.description: Client-dependent rate metrics. Zero values are treated as N/A.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, NULLIF(avg_tx_rate_mbps,0) AS "TX Mbps", NULLIF(avg_rx_rate_mbps,0) AS "RX Mbps" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND client_count > 0 AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,radio,ifname) timestamp,schema_version,device_id,network_type,radio,ifname,channel,frequency_mhz,bandwidth_mhz,channel_utilization_pct,tx_airtime_pct,rx_airtime_pct,cca_busy_pct,noise_floor_dbm,client_count,active_client_count,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_rssi_dbm END AS avg_rssi_dbm,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_rssi_dbm END AS min_rssi_dbm,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_snr_db END AS avg_snr_db,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_snr_db END AS min_snr_db,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_tx_rate_mbps END AS avg_tx_rate_mbps,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_rx_rate_mbps END AS avg_rx_rate_mbps,tx_packets,rx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_bytes,tx_retries,tx_failed,tx_airtime_client_pct,rx_airtime_client_pct,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_mcs END AS avg_mcs,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_mcs END AS min_mcs,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_nss END AS avg_nss,weak_client_count,neighbor_ap_count,strong_neighbor_ap_count,same_channel_ap_count,strong_same_channel_ap_count,obss_utilization_pct,interference_utilization_pct FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY device_id,radio,ifname,timestamp DESC;

panels.title: Channel Congestion Analysis
panels.description: Channel utilization, CCA, OBSS, interference and AP density.

targets.rawSql: SELECT radio,channel,frequency_mhz,bandwidth_mhz,ROUND(AVG(channel_utilization_pct)::numeric,1) AS avg_channel_utilization_pct,ROUND(AVG(cca_busy_pct)::numeric,1) AS avg_cca_busy_pct,ROUND(AVG(obss_utilization_pct)::numeric,1) AS avg_obss_pct,ROUND(AVG(interference_utilization_pct)::numeric,1) AS avg_interference_pct,MAX(neighbor_ap_count) AS neighbor_aps,MAX(strong_neighbor_ap_count) AS strong_neighbor_aps,MAX(same_channel_ap_count) AS same_channel_aps,MAX(strong_same_channel_ap_count) AS strong_same_channel_aps FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY radio,channel,frequency_mhz,bandwidth_mhz ORDER BY avg_channel_utilization_pct DESC;

SELECT timestamp AS time,tx_airtime_pct AS "TX Airtime %",rx_airtime_pct AS "RX Airtime %",tx_airtime_client_pct AS "Client TX Airtime %",rx_airtime_client_pct AS "Client RX Airtime %" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: TX Retries / Failures
panels.description: Raw cumulative counters. Alerting should use a retry ratio or rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time,tx_retries AS "TX Retries",tx_failed AS "TX Failed" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time,tx_packets AS "TX Packets",rx_packets AS "RX Packets" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Raw Telemetry — All 41 Fields
panels.description: Complete telemetry records. Client-dependent placeholder zeros are represented as N/A.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp,schema_version,device_id,network_type,radio,ifname,channel,frequency_mhz,bandwidth_mhz,channel_utilization_pct,tx_airtime_pct,rx_airtime_pct,cca_busy_pct,noise_floor_dbm,client_count,active_client_count,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_rssi_dbm END AS avg_rssi_dbm,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_rssi_dbm END AS min_rssi_dbm,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_snr_db END AS avg_snr_db,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_snr_db END AS min_snr_db,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_tx_rate_mbps END AS avg_tx_rate_mbps,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_rx_rate_mbps END AS avg_rx_rate_mbps,tx_packets,rx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_bytes,tx_retries,tx_failed,tx_airtime_client_pct,rx_airtime_client_pct,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_mcs END AS avg_mcs,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE min_mcs END AS min_mcs,CASE WHEN client_count=0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_nss END AS avg_nss,weak_client_count,neighbor_ap_count,strong_neighbor_ap_count,same_channel_ap_count,strong_same_channel_ap_count,obss_utilization_pct,interference_utilization_pct,clients FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Client JSONB Records
panels.description: Only records containing one or more client objects are displayed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp,device_id,network_type,radio,ifname,channel,client_count,jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(clients,'[]'::jsonb)) AS client_json_count,clients FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_id ~ '${device:regex}' AND radio ~ '${radio:regex}' AND ifname ~ '${ifname:regex}' AND network_type ~ '${network_type:regex}' AND channel::text ~ '${channel:regex}' AND jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(clients,'[]'::jsonb)) > 0 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500;
